test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2024: Official Paper (Held On: 03 Jul, 2024 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Which from following unemployment scheme was extended by the government of India for a period of two years from July 2022 to June 2024?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Atal Beemit Vyakti Kalyan Yojana**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Atal Beemit Vyakti Kalyan Yojana** was extended by the Government of India for a period of two years from July 2022 to June 2024.
 
• This scheme is aimed at providing financial assistance to unemployed individuals who have lost their jobs due to various reasons.
 
• The scheme is implemented by the Employees' State Insurance Corporation (ESIC) and provides relief to workers covered under the ESI scheme.
 
• Under this scheme, eligible unemployed individuals receive a cash benefit for up to 90 days during their unemployment period.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The **Atal Beemit Vyakti Kalyan Yojana** was initially introduced in 2018 as a pilot scheme for two years.
 
• The scheme was extended for the first time from July 2020 to June 2022 before the latest extension.
 
• To avail the benefits, the unemployed individual must have been in insurable employment for a minimum of two years.
 
• The individual must have contributed to the ESI scheme for at least 78 days in each of the four contribution periods immediately preceding the unemployment.
 
• This scheme is part of the government’s efforts to provide social security to workers in the organized sector.
 
• The financial assistance provided under the scheme is equivalent to 50% of the average daily earnings of the individual.
